name: jira_create_issue
description: Create a new Jira issue with optional Epic link or parent for subtasks.

assignee.description: (Optional) Assignee's user identifier (string): Email, display name, or account ID (e.g., 'user@example.com', 'John Doe', 'accountid:...')

components.description: (Optional) Comma-separated list of component names to assign (e.g., 'Frontend,API')

description.description: Issue description in Markdown format. On Jira Cloud, use '{expand:Title}...{expand}' for a collapsible section.

issue_type.description: Issue type (e.g. 'Task', 'Bug', 'Story', 'Epic', 'Subtask'). The available types depend on your project configuration. For subtasks, use 'Subtask' (not 'Sub-task') and include parent in additional_fields.

project_key.description: The JIRA project key (e.g. 'PROJ', 'DEV', 'ACV2'). This is the prefix of issue keys in your project. Never assume what it might be, always ask the user.
